summary: Frontend-only regression test for Room opening flow after TDZ fix in /app/frontend/app/room/[id].tsx. Logged in as testuser1, opened existing public room 'G', and confirmed RoomScreen mounts WITHOUT 'Cannot access t before initialization' ReferenceError. All 6 header buttons render (room-leave, room-mic-toggle, room-dms-open, room-friends-open, room-settings-open, room-fullscreen), chat-input is present, WebSocket connects ('1 live' shown next to green dot), and the DM overlay opens (Messages list shows 5 peer threads) and closes cleanly via room-dm-close, returning to the room with WS still alive. Zero TDZ / ReferenceError entries in console or pageerror listener. Mic button is tappable but on web preview the icon glyph length did not visibly change after one tap — most likely because navigator.mediaDevices permission resolves to 'denied'/'prompt' in headless Chromium and the toggle short-circuits with an Alert (expected behavior per code at room/[id].tsx:151-160, not a regression).
action_items: TDZ fix verified — no further action needed for this regression.

(Optional) On web preview, the mic permission prompt is suppressed by headless Chromium so the toggle silently does nothing after Alert dismissal. Consider showing a small inline toast for web users so they understand the mic only works on native builds.
critical_code_review_comments: Fix at room/[id].tsx:144 correctly moves `const { t, tErr } = useT();` before the `toggleMic` useCallback (which depends on `t`). The comment block at lines 140-143 explicitly documents the TDZ rationale — good defensive documentation.

Note: handleServerEvent (line 193) and several other callbacks below still reference `t` and have `t` in their dependency arrays; they remain correct because they are declared after the useT() call. The reorder fully resolves the TDZ chain.
seed_data_creation: None. Reused pre-existing public room 'G' (id cea9696b-5024-4f78-822f-c53d38d222cf) hosted by Amir4R that was already present in the rooms list.

rca_of_issue: ROOT CAUSE: In the previous commit (party4r-changes.zip merge), `const toggleMic = useCallback(async () => { ... t(...) ... }, [micMode, ensureMicPermission, setMicMode, t]);` was inserted ABOVE `const { t, tErr } = useT();`. JavaScript's `let`/`const` are subject to the Temporal Dead Zone — referencing `t` in the useCallback's dependency array on first render threw `ReferenceError: Cannot access 't' before initialization`, which crashed the RoomScreen function component and rendered nothing (blank screen → user reported 'لم استطع فتح غرفه'). FIX: useT() destructuring was moved up to line 144 (before toggleMic). REPRODUCTION (pre-fix): Login → tap any room card → blank screen + console error. MITIGATION (post-fix): Confirmed by browser automation — room mounts with full header, WS connects ('1 live'), chat composer renders, DM overlay opens/closes, no ReferenceError in console or pageerror handler.
